### COL weekly PDF

Runs **Monday 08:00 America/Bogota** or via **Run manually**. Uses the same **Browserless - api** credential as OSN. Chrome opens Metabase at `metabase-szaqo2-metabase-1:3000` on `dokploy-network` (not the nip.io host), injects `.emotion-d9z4sq { max-width: 1300px; }`, then CRM Bot uploads the PDF to **#col-team**.

### Emotion class can drift

`.emotion-d9z4sq` is generated CSS-in-JS. If a Metabase upgrade changes the hash, the width override stops applying and this selector needs updating.
